review_method.primary_method: Independently opened every assigned original candidate PNG with tools.view_image and compared it to each assigned original reference PNG, reusing a viewed original reference only within this batch.
review_method.image_scope: Only run 0c9ecf3777c9 originals and the assigned supplied reference originals were used. No old pixels, verdicts or contact-sheet substitutions were used.
review_method.text_scope: Read the assigned input, relevant frozen scope/plan sections and each case JSON, state sidecar, capture metadata, actions and stdout log as existing static text.

scope_documents.inspection: Identity supplied by the frozen input; original reference association and per-reference hashes come from the assigned input inventory.

skill.usage: Read the skill and applied its built-in review priority table to the existing frozen design. No search scripts or design generation were run; exact frozen declarations take precedence over generic recommendations.

review_method.scale: All candidates are the native 618x824 logical captures declared by their case/metadata. Original Paperwhite references are 1236x1648 at physical_reference_scale=2. Visual geometry was compared in normalized design coordinates without resizing or altering either original.
review_method.geometry_precision: Any coordinates or relative dimensions in this report are visual observations from the original views or declared metadata, not computed pixel-difference measurements.
review_method.hash_provenance: All SHA256 values are copied from the owner-frozen batch inventory and existing case records. No local rehash, hash verification or checksum probe was performed.
review_method.execution_boundary: Only local static text reads, original tools.view_image opens and writing this English report were performed. No SSH, app execution, build, test, smoke test, runtime probe, validation suite, copying, cropping or image processing was performed.
review_method.separation: Static appearance findings are separate from support provided by the existing captured actions/state/checks. Mechanical PASS and screenshots alone do not prove behavior or acceptance.
review_method.comparison_rules: Actual titles, covers, counts and dates are data exceptions. Geometry, typography hierarchy, legibility, outlines, clipping, whitespace, navigation allocation and selected/error/disabled affordances remain reviewable. Closed readers must remain artwork only.
review_method.readability: All required UI regions in these originals were sufficiently readable for the recorded checks. No unresolved original-crop request was needed.
